search.title: Search the official materials
search.subtitle: Searches only checked questions and confirmed rules of the active catalogues. Every result names its source and page.
search.method: Ask a question or type a term in Bosnian, German or English. Gemini translates the query into all three languages, finds passages of the official materials by meaning and by words, and answers only from them, citing the source. Without a key or semantic index the search works by words.
search.queryHint: For example: how long is the exam, calculator, Perfekt, Hasanaginica.
search.subject: Subject
search.refusal: The official materials contain no answer to this question.
search.empty: The index has no text yet. The Superadministrator builds it with "Build index".

index.title: Search index
index.intro: The index holds checked questions and confirmed rules of the active catalogues. Build it again after new review decisions; existing text stays.
